g.text: Frozen target supported: 16/16 exact graphs, zero missing edges; original gap heuristic recovers 6/16.
Same 64 clean banks in 16 quartets; 2,400 board appearances each. Sixteen new independent 18-cell profiles and new corruptions.
Minimize degree dispersion at count cuts no higher than the median; degree 20 and graph size 810 are not supplied.
All 2,408 candidates audited; the unique regular candidate is the true graph in every group. No minimum-degree or density guard.
Equal degree is a structural prior. Reused clean sources, different training work; no fresh-source or inference-accuracy claim.
